input: Source a secondhand sewing machine for alterations

gold.taskTitle: Source a secondhand sewing machine for alterations
gold.taskDescription: Find and acquire a used sewing machine suited for doing clothing alterations.

questions.title: What is your total budget for this machine?
questions.description: Understanding the price ceiling will determine which platforms, sellers, and machine models are realistic options.

questions.title: What types of fabric will you mainly be altering?
questions.description: Knowing whether the work involves denim, delicate fabrics, leather, or everyday garments affects which machine features are necessary.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred brand or model in mind?
questions.description: A brand preference or prior experience with a specific model narrows the search considerably.

questions.title: Is this for personal use or small business volume?
questions.description: The frequency and volume of alterations determines whether a basic domestic machine or a more heavy-duty model is appropriate.

questions.title: Do you want to buy locally or are you open to shipping?
questions.description: This affects which sourcing platforms to prioritise, such as local marketplaces versus national online listings.

questions.title: How soon do you need the machine ready to use?
questions.description: A tight timeline may rule out slower channels like auctions or distant sellers requiring shipping.

questions.title: Are you able to service or repair the machine yourself?
questions.description: Knowing whether the buyer can handle minor repairs influences how much condition risk is acceptable when evaluating secondhand options.
